title: M(ess)(y) Desk, motion recording, menus everywhere
thisBuild: The DESK tab is now M(ess)(y) Desk: tap Arrange, then drag any piece anywhere, drag its pink corner to resize it, let pieces overlap, and 📌 to pin one down. ⚙ picks a piece's pad and inner size.
Three layouts to start: Perform, Beats and Sampling, plus + New. Switch at the top of the desk, or add Desk layouts to the dock to flip through them while you play.

Motion recording: with Rec on while the loop plays, XY moves record into the loop and play back every time around. Your finger wins while it's moving. Clear moves is next to Clear loop, and in the loop letter's menu.

Hold, then lift, now opens menus in more places: sound names in Steps (the pad's menu), the pad name in Roll, loop letters (copy to the next empty loop, clear), song bars (clear, put a bar in, take one out), and sounds in the picker (hear, star, put on the pad, doctor, share).
Steps: tap a sound's name for its pitch strip. Pick a step, then a note, and that step plays at that pitch. Plain takes it back to a normal hit.
Pad names size themselves so long words don't break in the middle.
watch: Arrange a desk with two Padianos side by side and an XY for each.
Record a filter sweep with the XY while the loop plays, then take your hands off.
Give a bassline pitches straight from Steps.
limits: Jar tiles have no menu (there wasn't anything useful to put in one).
Recorded moves are XY moves; the dock's sliders and effect buttons don't record yet.
Creature cards, the Ring, jams and duels stay on the site.
